properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared npm dependencies of the documentation build (sha.js/hash.js-class SHA-1/SHA-2 JS libraries). Dependency inventory for the docs toolchain; the Go node itself hashes with crypto/sha256. Observable here, replaced only by bumping the docs build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 ECDSA is the node's alternative validator key type (via btcd/btcec): key generation, deterministic-nonce signing, verification, address derivation, proto/JSON codec registration, abci validator update mapping, tests. Quantum-vulnerable (Shor breaks secp256k1 discrete log); migration ML-DSA-65/SLH-DSA. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: math/rand (non-cryptographic PRNG) genuinely used: in 17 test/e2e/fuzz files for random test data, and in four production files — libs/rand/random.go (a Rand class explicitly documented as 'not suitable for cryptographic usage', seeded from crypto/rand, used for random strings/temp names), p2p/pex/addrbook.go (peer selection), light/provider/http/http.go, and statesync/snapshots.go (backoff/retry). No security-relevant consumer (keys, nonces, tokens) found; the codebase's own key/nonce generatio

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Poly1305 as the MAC component of ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD: the xchacha20poly1305 wrapper (crypto/xchacha20poly1305/xchachapoly.go), the production P2P secret-connection AEAD (secret_connection.go key/nonce constants), and the adversarial evil_secret_connection_test. AST re-rated this object to ChaCha20-Poly1305 uses. PQ-secure symmetric MAC; recorded as the transport's authentication layer.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: bcrypt cost 12 used only in crypto/xsalsa20symmetric tests to build password-derived test material; golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt is a declared dependency in go.mod.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge exposes RSA keygen/encrypt/sign for the docs build. Declared dependency only; no JS code in this repo invokes it — the Go node has no RSA use.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 is the node's primary signature scheme: validator consensus keys, node/P2P identity keys, privval remote-signing keys, vote/block/evidence signatures. 263 sites across 58 files (key types in abci/types and config/toml.go, codec registration, generated .pb.go, ed25519.go GenPrivKey/NewKeyFromSeed, priv_val_server, extensive tests). Quantum-vulnerable (Shor recovers the seed from public keys); migrate consensus identity to ML-DSA-65/SLH-DSA. Changeable here.

components.name: Go crypto/tls sessions on default settings (Go 1.18)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Enriched: the X25519 asset of the P2P secret-connection handshake includes BOTH curve25519 operations — ephemeral Curve25519 keypair generation via nacl/box.GenerateKey(crand.Reader) (secret_connection.go:294, CSPRNG-seeded) and the shared-secret computation curve25519.X25519 (line 371) — from which HKDF-SHA256 derives the two ChaCha20-Poly1305 session keys. Shor breaks this key agreement: recorded P2P traffic is decryptable in the future. Migrate to hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768 in a versioned hands

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Posture control implemented correctly: Equals methods on Ed25519/secp256k1/sr25519 private keys use crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare on key bytes rather than ==, preventing timing leakage during key comparisons.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 capability declared in the dependency graph (curve25519 sub-package of golang.org/x/crypto in go.mod; x25519 scalarmult available via tweetnacl/elliptic in the docs build) — consumed by the p2p secret connection in the Go code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 capability declared for the docs build via the elliptic npm package (docs/package-lock.json). No JS call site in this repo; the Go node's Ed25519 use is recorded under the main Ed25519 object.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA capability declared for the docs build via the elliptic npm package (transitive dep of the docs toolchain). Quantum-vulnerable (Shor breaks ECDSA); no call site in this repo's JS/Go code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDH capability declared for the docs build via the elliptic npm package. No call site in this repo; recorded as declared capability of the docs toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 is the node's canonical hash: tmhash (block/tx/app hashes), merkle tree hashing, secp256k1 signing hash (double-SHA over the digest), statesync snapshot digests, tx indexing, and the HKDF-SHA256 in the P2P secret connection. All 15 sites reviewed and genuine. SHA-256 is PQ-secure (Grover only halves preimage strength); recorded as the system hash standard.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HKDF-SHA256 key derivation in the P2P secret-connection handshake: hkdf.New(hash, dhSecret, nil, secretConnKeyAndChallengeGen) expands the X25519 shared secret into the session's two AEAD keys+challenge (secret_connection.go:342-345); consumed by both ChaCha20-Poly1305 and legacy XSalsa20-Poly1305 variants. Not itself quantum-vulnerable, but it feeds keys derived from a Shor-vulnerable KEX.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Enriched: the docs/package-lock.json browser crypto stack (crypto-browserify + cipher shims) that this AES object represents also declares md5.js v1.3.5 (MD5 — collision-broken hash, CWE-328) and ripemd160 v2.0.2 (RIPEMD-160) as capability entries of the same lockfile — reported as findings but already covered by this manifest object. The Go node itself uses no AES. Observable docs-toolchain dependencies; replaceable by pruning the docs build's transitive graph.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 capability declared for the docs build via the pbkdf2 npm package (browser crypto stack). The Go side uses bcrypt/x/crypto KDFs instead; no JS call site in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD protects the P2P secret connection transport: keys derived via HKDF-SHA256 from the X25519 handshake, frames sealed with chacha20poly1305 (secret_connection.go); the xchacha20poly1305 package wraps it for extended nonces; evil_secret_connection_test simulates a malicious peer. PQ-secure AEAD — the quantum exposure of this transport is the X25519 KEX feeding it, not the cipher.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: XSalsa20-Poly1305-256 (secretbox) capability declared: golang.org/x/crypto/nacl/secretbox in go.mod backs the crypto/xsalsa20symmetric package (the legacy Tendermint transport encryption used before ChaCha20-Poly1305), and tweetnacl in the docs build provides the same construction. Symmetric AEAD — not quantum-vulnerable; recorded for completeness.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: golang.org/x/crypto/chacha20poly1305 (ChaCha20-Poly1305, 256-bit key) declared in go.mod and used as the AEAD of the P2P secret connection (secret_connection.go) and as the inner cipher of the xchacha20poly1305 wrapper. Symmetric AEAD — PQ-safe; recorded as the KDF-output consumer.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto/rand (CSPRNG) is the randomness source for security material: ephemeral X25519 handshake keys and AEAD nonces in the P2P secret connection (secret_connection.go), xsalsa20symmetric nonces, the pex addrbook's HighwayHash key (newHashKey), and the crypto/random.go helper consumed by key generation. Tests use it for random data. Correct posture — not the math/rand path used for non-security randomness.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JWT signing capability recorded only in the module graph: go.sum contains github.com/dgrijalva/jwt-go and github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v4 (HMAC-SHA-class JWT signing). Grep confirms no .go file in this repo imports either; they are transitive module-graph entries required for checksum verification. Observable here, changeable only by pruning the dependency that pulls them.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl JS library declared for the docs build (docs/package-lock.json + root manifest): provides the XSalsa20-Poly1305 secretbox and Curve25519 box constructions in JS. No JS call site in this repo; capability inventory for the docs toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge JS library declared for the docs build: the package that provides the X.509 certificate and RSA keygen/encrypt/sign capabilities already recorded as separate capability objects (ALG-1847d707, ALG-589856a1). Dependency inventory for the docs toolchain; no JS call site in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: self-signed X.509 certificate generation capability declared for the docs build (selfsigned npm package, typically for local dev HTTPS of the docs site). Not used by the Go node, which takes user-supplied cert/key files for RPC TLS.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X.509 certificate machinery (node-forge) declared for the docs build: certificate creation/parsing/signing capabilities vendored with the docs toolchain. Observable dependency inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: golang.org/x/crypto (extended Go cryptography) is a direct dependency providing the node's actual crypto: curve25519 (X25519 KEX), chacha20poly1305 (AEAD), hkdf (KDF), nacl/secretbox (legacy AEAD), bcrypt (test KDF), openpgp (deprecated, apparently unused). The version pinned here decides post-quantum capability — no ML-KEM/ML-DSA subpackages present. Changeable here via go.mod.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Correction to earlier note: the deprecated golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp IS imported by the application — crypto/armor/armor.go:8 imports openpgp/armor (the ASCII-armored encoding layer, frozen upstream with known CVEs in the wider openpgp package) to armor/unarmor key material. The OpenPGP message crypto itself is not called; only the armor encoding. Changeable here by replacing the armor dependency.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: DNSSEC validation capability present via github.com/miekg/dns in the module graph (go.sum): the package implements DNSSEC chain verification and DNS crypto (RSA/ECDSA/Ed25519 signing of DNS records). Not imported by this repo's Go sources; transitive module-graph entry.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: golang.org/x/crypto/curve25519 declared in go.mod: the library backing the live X25519 key agreement in the P2P secret-connection handshake (recorded under ALG-1138d04b). Quantum-vulnerable primitive; capability changeable only by swapping the handshake construction.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: golang.org/x/crypto/nacl declared in go.mod: provides secretbox (used by crypto/xsalsa20symmetric's EncryptSymmetric/DecryptSymmetric) and box (Curve25519 keypair generation used by the secret-connection handshake at secret_connection.go:294). Symmetric constructions; the box keygen feeds the Shor-vulnerable X25519 KEX.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v4 recorded in go.sum only: JWT signing/verification capability in the module graph (HMAC-SHA based by default). No .go file in this repo imports it — transitive checksum entry. Observable, changeable only by pruning the pulling dependency.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: github.com/dgrijalva/jwt-go recorded in go.sum only: the ABANDONED upstream JWT library (known algorithm-confusion issues, CVE-2020-26160; superseded by golang-jwt). No .go file in this repo imports it — transitive checksum entry. If any dependency actually links it, its HS256/none-confusion weakness becomes reachable; recorded for the dependency inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt declared in go.mod: password-based KDF used at cost 12 in crypto/xsalsa20symmetric tests (the documented secret-preparation recipe for the legacy symmetric encryption helper). OWASP-adequate cost. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha.js declared for the docs build (docs/package-lock.json): JS implementations of the SHA family (SHA-1/SHA-224/SHA-256/384/512) for the browser toolchain. No JS call site in this repo; docs-build dependency inventory.

properties.value: elliptic JS library declared for the docs build (docs/package-lock.json): provides ECDSA, ECDH, Ed25519 and secp256k1-style curve operations in JS.
